steps.text: Each player: a Followers Bag, {n} coins, 7 markers, a Player Board, a Merchant Token and 10 Trading Stations
Your 4 starting Followers (Farmer, Boatman, Craftsman, Trader) on the Market Spaces of your board
1 marker on the first space of each Character Track and the Development Track
Game board and Beneficial Deeds board on the table; Technology Tiles stacked on their space
Hour Glass Tiles: set the Pilgrimage tile aside, shuffle the rest facedown onto their space, Pilgrimage on top
Neutral Character Tiles sorted by profession onto their buildings
3 players: remove 2 each of the neutral Farmer, Boatman, Craftsman and Trader and 3 each of the Knight, Scholar and Monk
2 players: remove 4 each of the neutral Farmer, Boatman, Craftsman and Trader and 6 each of the Knight, Scholar and Monk
13 Citizen Tiles on the marked spaces of both boards; the last one on the table
Place Tiles sorted by Roman numeral into two stacks
Shuffle the Goods Tiles and place 1 faceup on each Road and Waterway space; sort the rest onto the Goods Market
steps.note: 3 players: leave spaces marked 4 empty. 2 players: leave spaces marked 3 or 4 empty

steps.text: Coins on the table close at hand
The youngest player takes the Start Player Token and turns over the first Hour Glass Tile (always Pilgrimage)
